rationale: Roberts is best positioned to write a narrow, institutionally cautious opinion applying Philipp’s domestic-takings rule as a jurisdictional gatekeeper and cabining jurisdictional discovery to genuinely, plausibly pleaded disputes. Sotomayor is likely to dissent emphasizing targeted jurisdictional discovery and access-to-justice concerns, while Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch/Jackson have some chance of separate concurrences to sharpen pleading-and-discovery limits under the FSIA.
